items.title: Lee Paige Interview, 1961-01-13
items.q: So I was appearing in a show with her and she was going on that and she said to me

ctx.x: Lee, how about that old spiel that she used about come up and see me sometime?

Oh yes, I always get a kick out of Mae West when she always says, come up and see me sometime. So I was appearing in a show with her and she was going on that and she said to me, she said, well, why don't you come up and see me sometime? I said, well, Mae, I can't come up and see you. She said, why? I said, well, I'm a coon shouter and I'd be shouting too loud.
And then did Mae give any comment to that, peel me a grape?
